result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 2 (Government), Article 2, Division 10, covering the City employee Suggestion Awards Program, industrial leave, and procedures under Charter Section 129.1 on strikes; despite the source URL's reference to algorithmic rent price-fixing, this part contains no rental housing rules.
result.notes: This part of the document consists solely of municipal-employee administrative provisions (sections 22.1007-22.1023: suggestion awards, committee, industrial leave, strike prohibition procedures). None of it addresses rent increase limits, just cause eviction, security deposits, application screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting, so the rule list is empty. The Division 11 text on algorithmic rent-setting (§98.1103) referenced in the source URL does not appear in this part.
